<!-- pr-reviewer: 942fbcdbe10eeb31169c5db311b2266872db3367 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The Gate map names the three app modules that the suite covers. The new test checks selection from each module. The change meets issue #2411.

Local results against upstream/main `c605e5687c9197ff667092f001f9383384e35d01`:

- The trial merge succeeds. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects the DXF MCP suite and the xtask unit tests.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes both steps. The DXF MCP suite passes 1 test. The xtask targets pass 151, 3, and 3 tests. No test fails or is ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.

The change affects test selection only. It changes no posted G-code, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation, geometry, goldens, or UI. Safety mutations are not required. I did not repeat the author's header mutation. No code was changed during this review.

The body has `Process change: yes`, a `Changelog:` line, and `Fixes #2411`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
